Relationships between TKW and GFD were significantly positive over the all populations (y = 0.21x + 44; P < 0.001, R2 = 0.17) and for the top 10% of the SDL populations (y = 0.15x + 46; P < 0.001, R2 = 0.05) in the IRRI.Y11.12 trial.
